statement: Random Forest Regressor was the best market valuation model on holdout data.
Nonlinear ensembles substantially outperformed the linear baseline.
Engineered domain features were informative but did not improve direct price regression.
The weighted content-based recommender achieved the best offline utility.
Hybrid and knowledge-based methods perfectly satisfied hard constraints, but did not surpass content_weighted on utility.
Collaborative signal remained the weakest component inside the hybrid recommendation stage.
The integrated shortlist contained market-underpriced objects relative to the learned valuation model.
The final DSS pipeline reduced a large candidate pool to a compact shortlist suitable for human review.
